scripted_market_orders.source_policy: Orders are deterministic market events injected by the prewarm runner after the seeded markets exist; sales department actions must only accept/reject/pass these orders.

default_pass_reasons.finance: Keep finance visible every day, but do not let liquidity discipline dominate before handoff because this case is about workforce execution rather than cash.
default_pass_reasons.hr: Keep HR visible every day, but do not solve the future staffing bottleneck early. The headcount shock is introduced later and must still be visible at handoff.
default_pass_reasons.sales: Open the seeded markets up front, then keep converting deterministic market-originated orders into committed backlog. Do not leave a large available-order pool that would let the handoff drift back into a market-insufficiency story.
default_pass_reasons.production: Use short bridge plans to keep the firm visibly operating through day9, then enter handoff with one fully occupied line and one idle line so the visible blocker is labor rather than equipment.
default_pass_reasons.inventory: Keep warehouse pressure low and let stock movements tell the staffing story. Inventory should observe rather than expand.
default_pass_reasons.procurement: Deliberately avoid creating procurement pressure before takeover. Suppliers should exist, but raw material should still remain sufficient at handoff.
